product.name: Highlander Men's Straight Fit Jeans
product.description: Highlander men's straight-fit jeans designed for everyday comfort and casual styling. The product uses soft, breathable cotton denim with a relaxed fit, mid-rise construction and a straight leg silhouette.

review_summary.summary: Reviews are mixed. Positive buyers praise the material, comfort, appearance and value for money. The dominant negative theme is inconsistent sizing and fit, with multiple buyers reporting loose sizing or needing exchanges. There are also some complaints about fabric quality.

review_summary.main_concern: Sizing and fit consistency. The product is officially described as relaxed fit, so customers expecting a standard straight or slimmer fit may find it too loose.

appearance.note: The product is positioned as a classic, modern everyday jean and several reviews describe it positively.

comfort.note: Multiple reviews mention comfort, while the product description emphasizes soft and breathable cotton.

material_quality.note: Several customers praised the material, but at least one verified buyer described the jeans as very poor quality.

fit.note: Fit is the clearest weakness. Buyers reported non-standard sizing, excessive looseness and multiple exchanges.

comfort.note: Customers specifically reported good comfort and the product is made from soft cotton.

value_for_money.note: The ₹598 snapshot price and several positive reviews support good perceived value.

durability.note: The source does not provide enough consistent long-term durability evidence.

colour.note: Multiple colour variants are available, but the supplied reviews do not provide enough evidence to rank colour durability.

buying_advice.size_advice: Do not blindly select your usual size. Reviews indicate inconsistent sizing, including excessive looseness and exchanges. Check the size chart and consider the relaxed-fit construction before ordering.
buying_advice.style_advice: Best paired with T-shirts, hoodies and casual shirts for a relaxed everyday look.
buying_advice.care_advice: The supplied source does not provide sufficiently detailed care instructions, so do not invent specific washing instructions.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the 100% cotton fabric, relaxed straight silhouette, comfort and low price. Do not claim perfect sizing or premium quality. If the customer asks about fit, explicitly warn that sizing feedback is inconsistent.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Explain that this is a Highlander men's relaxed straight-fit jean made from 100% cotton, with a mid-rise design and casual styling.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend conditionally. The strongest positives are cotton fabric, comfort and price. The biggest concern is inconsistent sizing and some negative quality feedback.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Say that several customers praise the material, but quality feedback is mixed. Do not describe it as premium or guaranteed durable.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the listed fit is Relaxed with a Straight leg and Mid Rise. Warn that several customers reported loose or inconsistent sizing.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_colors: The supplied product images represent Blue, Faint Blue, Grey, Light Blue and Navy Fade.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_price: The supplied product snapshot shows ₹598 against an MRP of ₹2,599, representing a 77% discount.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_stretch: Do not claim that the jeans are stretchable. The source specifies cotton fabric but does not provide a confirmed stretch specification.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_size: Recommend checking the size chart because multiple reviews report inconsistent sizing and loose fit.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: If the customer specifically wants a predictable or fitted silhouette, prioritize products with stronger sizing feedback or a clearly defined slim/regular fit.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Match the product primarily against relaxed-fit, straight-leg and cotton-jeans preferences. Penalize it for requests requiring precise sizing or a fitted silhouette.
